description: Department of Labour - Notifying that the Cost of Living Index Number for the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper Growing and Manufacturing Trade for the Month of May 2016 being 114.4, the Special Allowance in respect of a normal working day in the Month of June 2016 will be Rs. 646.06
categorisation: This gazette notification announces a special allowance payable to workers in specific agricultural trades based on the Cost of Living Index Number. It falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) as it deals with public sector service conditions and benefits for workers, specifically addressing wage adjustments and allowances in accordance with the Wages Boards Ordinance. The content does not involve government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3) or fit any other specialized categories (4-7, 9), making Type 8 the appropriate classification.
